topic: A homeowner discovers previous residents left items in the attic
text: I step into the attic, the air thick with dust and silence. My eyes narrow as I scan the space cluttered with remnants of lives past. Shards of light poke through the cracks, illuminating the ghosts of those who dared to leave their mark. Every item, a silent accusation. I move through the debris, each step deliberate, a storm brewing within. These things, they claim space, air, light—things that should be mine alone. The walls seem to whisper of their presumptuous claim to this domain. It’s a challenge, unspoken yet thunderous in its echo. I won’t stand for it. Not here, not now. This place, it belongs to me, and I will reclaim it, piece by piece.
